# DeployMyClaw — deploymyclaw.ai

**DeployMyClaw** is the deployment platform of the Claw AI family: connect your AI agent (code, ClawTool export, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) and it goes live in the EU with REST/WhatsApp/Slack endpoints, built-in monitoring, versioning/rollback and per-run cost control.

## Product
- One-click deploy — live endpoint in seconds
- Endpoints: REST, WhatsApp, Slack, webhooks (per agent)
- Monitoring: latency, errors, tokens, spend; alerts
- Versions, A/B splits, one-click rollback
- Cost control: per-run meters, daily spend caps, model fallback
- EU hosting, per-tenant isolation, no cross-border data moves by default

## Pricing (EUR)
| Plan | Price | Includes |
|---|---|---|
| Hobby | €0 | 1 agent, 1k runs/mo, REST + email, 7-day history |
| Pro | €29/mo | 5 agents, 20k runs/mo, all endpoints, 90-day history + alerts, A/B + rollback, spend caps |
| Scale | €99/mo | unlimited agents, 100k runs/mo, team + SSO, 99.9% SLA |

## Contact
- Email: hello@deploymyclaw.ai
- Web: https://deploymyclaw.ai/ (English and French)

## Data & privacy
- Static marketing site: no visitor data stored; contact via mailto.
- Platform: EU data centers, per-tenant isolation, log retention per tenant setting (7/90/off), credentials in the customer's vault, no shared-model training, export at any time.
